supersede_reason: Invoice 1026-08 total moved USD 4,866.33 -> USD 4,987.39. The omitted US single-entry bond of USD 121.06 was re-invoiced by 5 Continent on 2026-10-09 and paid by Wise on 2026-10-21 (txn #2448368244, gross USD 124.19). v1 captured a single payment and therefore under-states landed cost.
packing_model_disabled_reason: This basis carries FLAT invoiced line items from invoice 1026-08; the dynamic pallet/packaging model is applied on the forward-quote basis, not here.
air_freight_rate_notes: Air freight is a FLAT invoiced line (USD 1,241.00 billed at 365 kg x USD 3.40). The AWB records 349 kg and the carrier HAWB rate is USD 2.30/kg; the 365 kg x 3.40 basis was accepted and paid as-is and is NOT restated here. Separately, 5 Continent's own written quote was a flat USD 1,118.60 - the USD 122.40 excess is an open commercial claim (see open_claims) and is deliberately NOT netted into this basis. Do NOT re-scale by weight for this actuals basis.

landed_cost.basis_statement: Freight is weight/volume driven, so the uplift is apportioned by shipped weight, matching how the v1 pool was built. Apportioning by VALUE instead would inflate high-cost items and is explicitly rejected.

weight_reconciliation.note: Accepted v1 rounding (per-ledger weights sum to 302.057 kg vs 302.06 kg in packing_actuals). Allocation uses ledger weights; per-kg uses 302.06.

financing_waterfall.policy: Self-fund first from each ledger's own USD cash; AGL15 (the syndicate) finances only the remaining shortfall. Shares are unchanged from v1, so the increment follows the same borrower split.

increment_attribution.note: AGL8 and AGL13 have insufficient own USD, so their increments become additional debt. Main funds its increment from its own USD cash and borrows nothing extra.
increment_attribution.rounding_note: Un-rounded weight-proportional values are 18.0083 and 49.5433. Posting increments in whole cents (18.01 / 49.54) makes the borrower increments sum to exactly 67.55, matching the AGL15 outlay increment; the un-rounded pair would sum to 67.552 and leave a 0.002 drift against the outlay row.

agl15_state_terminology.note: Two DIFFERENT quantities live on the AGL15 Balance tab and must never be conflated. A review of v1 flagged exactly this conflation; this block exists to pin the definitions.

outlay_cumulative_usd.definition: Cumulative principal AGL15 has deployed = SUM of all NEGATIVE USD rows on AGL15 Transactions = absolute value of the 'USD' line in the Balance ASSET block (col E/F).
outlay_cumulative_usd.note: Unchanged by this snapshot. AGL15 Transactions t56 (20261014) already carries -2,098.354 for the 5 Continent freight shortfall.

usd_balance_usd.definition: AGL15's own remaining USD cash = SUM of ALL signed USD rows on AGL15 Transactions = absolute value of the 'Gary Teh' line in the Balance RESOURCE LOCATION block (col H/I).

capital_contributed_usd.definition: Total USD capital put into AGL15 = sum of POSITIVE USD rows on Transactions.

after_true_up_formula.why: AGL8 and AGL13 have no usable own USD (AGL8 Balance shows USD = 0; AGL13 has no USD asset line at all), so both increments fall to AGL15. 18.01 + 49.54 = 67.55.
after_true_up_formula.deliberately_not_hardcoded: Absolute post-state values are NOT published here. Two pinned pre-booking baselines were found STALE on live read (AGL15 USD was pinned at 2,142.396 vs live 2,518.046). Post-state must be computed from the live figure at posting time.

open_claims.do_not_lead_with: The carrier HAWB (349 kg x USD 2.30 = 802.70) implies a 438.30 spread, but that is 5CL's own buy-side margin (MAWB settles at a nominal minimum). Leading with it turns a contract point into a margin debate. Use the quoted rate (122.40), not the HAWB.

late_fee.status: Never charged by vendor; NOT waived in writing. Get explicit written waiver.

mpf_gap.status: Quoted but ABSENT from invoice 1026-08, and duties proven to be duty-only, so MPF was likely omitted the same way the bond was. Expect a possible third invoice; request a final-and-settled confirmation.

rejected_treatments.treatment: Treat the 121.06 as uncollected bank fees
rejected_treatments.why_rejected: Bank fees cannot raise an invoice TOTAL. The total itself moved 4,866.33 -> 4,987.39, which only a re-invoiced charge explains.

rejected_treatments.treatment: Treat the 121.06 as a double charge inside Customs Duties 128.53
rejected_treatments.why_rejected: 128.53 is duty only - proven because the duty-advance fee 12.85 is exactly 10% of it. Bond and MPF sit outside that line.

rejected_treatments.treatment: Credit the bond against the 937.20 dispute claim
rejected_treatments.why_rejected: Different transactions and different directions. The bond is a charge we owe and paid; the claim is money owed back.

rejected_treatments.treatment: Apportion the uplift by item VALUE (+2.536%)
rejected_treatments.why_rejected: Freight is weight/volume driven. Value apportionment would put roughly 4x the correct uplift on the ceremonial pouch (+0.35 vs +0.08).

rejected_treatments.treatment: Amortise the 937.20 open claim into unit cost
rejected_treatments.why_rejected: Contingent. No credit until cash lands; booking it would understate inventory.

rejected_treatments.treatment: Write into the AGL Balance tabs directly
rejected_treatments.why_rejected: Balance cols A/B (Equity), E/F (Asset) and H/I (Resource Location) are query() spills over Transactions. Append signed rows to Transactions; the spills recompute.
